mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate continued liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering recession expectations that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market pricing anticipates reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 8.5%), a federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as equity valuations face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting CPIAUCSL YoY > 8.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates robust supply-side economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through elevated corporate profitability expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units signal weakening residential construction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market pricing anticipates broader economic deceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods following HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-employment regimes (PAYEMS > 145.0 million), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals labor market deterioration, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through recession risk pricing.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting PAYEMS > 145.0 million and UNRATE > 4.5%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1 YoY > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days through sustained corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following GDPC1 YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
